title: Nature's Bittersweet Staple: Chokecherry's Importance Across Habitats and Cultures
author: Beehive Guide
lead: Chokecherries feed birds, bears and bees. They've also long been a staple food for Native American tribes and frontier settlers.

title: Is Chicory a Weed? How to Identify It, What It's Used For and How to Control It
author: Beehive Guide
lead: Chicory's blue flowers brighten roadsides across the country, but some states call it a noxious weed. Learn how to spot it, what it's good for and how to keep it in check.
